parsed.explanation: Traveler-facing exposures are documented and state-imposed, though none is a universal adult facility exclusion of the kind that marks the 0.35 tier: there is no state-wide birth-sex bathroom rule for adults and no documented police sweeps or extortion of trans visitors. What remains is serious: entry adjudication letting officers refuse cases where documents cast doubt on sex and weigh materiality toward permanent ineligibility, with case-note tagging and detentions of travellers reported; immigration custody records forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse and denial of care; medical practitioners may statutorily refuse LGBT patients; and Act 619's misdemeanour for trans bathroom use with a minor present, plus the extended K-12 ban, is a live criminal edge. State-level hate-crime and accommodation protection for gender identity is absent, leaving only partial national recourse. Care ban, athletics ban and marker rescission are resident-facing climate signals only.
